newsitem.title: CROATIA: Texaco said to mull investment in Croatia.
newsitem.headline: Texaco said to mull investment in Croatia.

text.p: Global oil giant Texaco Inc. plans to invest in filling stations throughout Croatia, local newspapers reported on Friday.
Texaco this week began negotiations with local partners on jointly operating filling stations under its name and according to its standards, daily newspaper Vjesnik said.
The state investment promotion agency was said to be in charge of the talks.

Texaco was interested in opening between 50 and 70 new outlets that would "provide new jobs for the local population over the next five years", its central and eastern European development chief Richard Albert was quoted as saying.
Apart from fuel, these outlets would also have car-wash units, restaurants, shops and rest rooms, Vjesnik said.
There was no figure for the planned investment.
Texaco was also reported to be mulling registering a local subsidiary under the name Texaco Hrvatska. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
